selection_scope: One next document-specific complete-pipeline candidate; no quality rank or accepted Processing Profile

recognition.model_name_rule: Absolute local snapshot path after acquisition and manifest verification; never a moving HF main request

runtime.paddle_client: Isolated environment not created; transitive lock pending

prompting.routing: Official full pipeline: algorithm/text OCR:, formula Formula Recognition:, table Table Recognition:, chart Chart Recognition:

supplement: live image bytes keyed to block/page provenance
source PNG mapping, original asset hash, processed coordinate-space metadata and logical grouping where established
output.docling_importer_input: Original per-page result only; not concatenated/restructured multipage JSON

source_context.renderer_scope: Four source pages times two backends equals eight rendered inputs, not eight distinct pages; six approved usable inputs and two rejected black DoclingParse validation inputs; original pixels unchanged
source_context.onward_input_rule: Only approved images may be passed onward
source_context.contiguous_pages: The current four source pages are not a contiguous-page set; separately fix and approve contiguous ranges from each source for cross-page contexts. Preserve original per-page results before live-object official restructure_pages; no claim of paragraph joining

remaining_content_gaps: plain algorithm is not code fenced
separate inline_formula blocks are not reassembled into prose
bare formulas are not given math delimiters by native exporter
Docling supplement loses provider grouping/polygons and some table header roles
image bytes and source hash need explicit supplement
provider pipeline math normalization can affect dollar literals in mixed code/math

stop_rule: Do not begin model inference before native result/export and actual Paddle input preflight are reviewable; do not automatically select another model when a blocker remains
